# Referendum.social

> Explore public opinion polls from around the world in English.

Browse polls by topic or tag, vote, compare results and discuss the questions. Results reflect self-selected participants, not representative surveys or official elections. The site is independent of governments and political parties.

## Polls and news
- [Global polls](https://referendum.social/): Public polls and results.
- [News](https://en.referendum.social/news): Articles and site updates.

## Country editions
- [United States](https://en.referendum.social/): Latest USA polls.
- [Ukraine](https://ua.referendum.social/): Polls in Ukrainian.
- [Russia](https://ru.referendum.social/): Polls in Russian.
- [Norway](https://no.referendum.social/): Polls in Norwegian.
- [New Zealand](https://nz.referendum.social/): Polls in English.
